result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a bottom card cut off by the tab bar, and the search field sitting under the status bar area. Also a likely nav-state mismatch (Profile highlighted on the home feed).

issues.description: The third restaurant in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, so the name and card edge are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and either fully show a peek of the next card or clip cards with enough inset so names and images are never truncated mid-character.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza, −20%) is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so the title, rating, and delivery info are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category chips row is cut off on the right (only a sliver of the next pill is visible) with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Give the last visible chip more peek or a fade/scroll indicator, and ensure chips aren’t flush against the screen edge.

issues.description: The search field sits very close to the status bar / delivery header with little breathing room, making the top of the screen feel cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase spacing below the address row so the search bar isn’t tight against the status/header cluster.

issues.description: The bottom tab highlights Profile (green) while the screen is clearly the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Keep the selected tab in sync with the current screen (Home should be active on this view).

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol” is truncated without an ellipsis, so it’s unclear the name is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Use a single-line truncate with an ellipsis, or allow the name to wrap so the full title is readable.
